header.source: KNOWLEDGE · etymology joined to atoms, anon door

rows.definition: The rearranging of a whole's parts and their relations. Restructuring changes what is possible without changing what is there.
What comes back after a thing is done. From the Latin for rebound - a result is the leap returning, not the leap.
To take up again what was paused. Resuming assumes the state was kept.
How long a thing is kept before it is let go. A retention rule is an ethical decision wearing a technical name.
To draw back what was extended — a claim withdrawn, a reach returned; reversal done openly.
To draw back to safer ground — withdrawal as wisdom, not defeat; and the quiet place one withdraws to.
The bringing back of what was stored. Retrieval is the whole reason keeping is done at all.
To bring back what was stored. Retrieval assumes the keeping was done well enough to find it again.
To attempt again after failing. Retrying assumes the failure was of the moment rather than of the method.
To come back, and to give back. Both senses close a circuit that was opened.
To look again at a thing with judgment. A review is a second seeing, made deliberately.
To see again and amend — change made by second sight, in the open.
What good doing brings back — return earned, not extracted; in this house's games, the reward is the words.
Colour stated as amounts of red, green and blue. A named encoding rather than a concept.
Colour stated as red, green, blue and how opaque it is. A named encoding rather than a concept.
A long narrow band, used to bind, to mark, or to honour. Its narrowness is what makes it a sign rather than a covering.
The side opposite left. Also what one is owed — the same word for a direction and for a just claim.
A closed circle, and the sounding of a bell. Both are things that return to themselves.
To move upward under one's own becoming — ascent; what the sun, bread, and hope do.
The chance of harm, weighed against its size. Risk is respected rather than feared — the two produce opposite decisions.
A form repeated on purpose so meaning can gather in it. What makes it a ritual is that the doing matters as much as the outcome.
Row-level security — rules deciding which rows a given reader may see. Permission enforced in the data itself rather than above it.
A stated order of what comes next and roughly when. A roadmap is an intention, not a promise.
A part played, with duties attached to the part rather than the person. A role can be left; the record of holding it stays.
The returning of a system to a prior known state. A rollback undoes an attempt without pretending it never happened.
A bounded space within a larger dwelling, given over to one purpose. Also the space available for a thing to exist in.
The part a thing grows from and is anchored by. Also the base form a family of words descends from.
To turn about a centre. Also to replace in turn — the same word for spinning and for taking turns.
Turning about a centre. Also taking turns in order — both return to where they began.
Having its corners taken off. Softened at the edges so nothing catches.
A chosen way from one place to another. A route is one path among many, and choosing it excludes the rest.
That which decides where each thing should go. A router does no work itself and determines everything's path.
One line in an ordered set. A single record standing in succession with its kind.
A statement of what must or must not be. A rule differs from a description in that breaking it has consequence.
To carry a process through from start to finish. Also one such carrying, considered as a single event.
The conditions under which a thing actually runs, as opposed to how it was written. Where design meets what is really there.
The language this house builds its sovereign local tools in. A named language rather than a concept.
Set apart and not to be treated casually. Sacredness is a decision a community keeps, not a property a thing has.
Low of mood in the presence of loss. The feeling that something mattered and is missed — sorrow doing its honest work, not a malfunction.
Not exposed to harm. Safety is a condition of the place, not a quality of the one in it.
Of the named desert and the region around it. A named place rather than a concept.
An exchange of a thing for payment. A sale transfers what is held and settles the obligation.
A part taken to stand for the whole. A sample is only as good as the honesty of how it was chosen.
A place where a being is safe by the nature of the place, not by permission. Safety that does not have to be re-earned at the door.
The innermost set-apart place. A sanctum is not merely private; it is protected by what it is for.
A bounded place where things may be tried without consequence outside it. Safety made by walls rather than by care.
To remove what could do harm before letting a thing through. Sanitising is a judgment about danger made in advance.
The quality of clarity, balance and light, in the Sanskrit reckoning of the three qualities. Not goodness as reward but as a settled state.
To put beyond loss. Both rescuing a thing and committing it to keeping.
The size of a thing relative to a reference, and the act of changing it. Also a graded series for measuring.
To pass over a whole quickly, looking for what matters. A scan trades depth for coverage on purpose.
Passed under the reading eye — walked line by line and taken in. The participle standing alone in the corpus's names.
That which passes over a whole quickly, reporting what it meets. Coverage traded against depth by design.
A story, a tale, a piece of news — the thing one person carries to another. Irish; what the seanchaí keeps and gives aloud. Older than any medium that holds it. This house's video studio.
A bounded stretch of happening, held as one view. Everything within it shares a place and a moment.
A plan laid against time. A schedule is an intention with hours attached.
The declared shape of a thing. The form something is held in, named before it is filled.
A named way of organizing — the lattice's own unit: one lens that groups concepts into a view.
The bounds within which a thing applies. Scope is what keeps a rule from reaching where it was not meant to.
A number standing for how well a thing did. Also the written form of a piece of music — both are performance set down as marks.
To mix into disorder, and also to move over rough ground on hands and feet. One word for two motions: what is scrambled has been disarranged, and the one who scrambles is working to cross something.
A surface that shows, and a barrier that hides. The same word for what displays and what conceals.
Written instructions to be performed. A plan for action, held in words until something runs it.
To move a view across matter longer than the frame. Also the rolled document that gave the motion its name.
Longer than its frame, so a view can be moved across it. Of a thing whose whole cannot be seen at once.
The mark showing how much lies beyond the frame and where you are within it. It measures the unseen.
The great water — depth, tide, and horizon; where every river's telling ends and weather begins.

The keeper of lore and the one who tells it — the memory of a place, carried in a person and given aloud. Irish, seanchaí. The keeping and the telling are one office; a record nobody speaks is not what this word means.
Irish: the keeper of the spoken lore — the one who holds what was said so it is not lost.
To look for what may not be there. Searching differs from retrieving in that the outcome is not promised.
Able to be found by asking. Searchability is a property of how a thing was kept, not of the thing.
The field where a seeking is typed. The visible mouth of a search.
A stretch of time with its own weather and work. A season is named by what it is for.
A place made for one to sit and belong. In a council, a seat is a standing to speak that persists between meetings.
Short form of second, and of section. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
Second in order or in importance. Naming something secondary makes something else primary by implication.
The base unit of counted time. Also those who come after the first — the same word for a moment and for a rank.
What stays pointers, never contents — keys and credentials, held in .env files, referenced everywhere, exposed nowhere.
A part obtained by cutting the whole. Not a natural joint but a chosen one - a section is where someone decided to divide.
The condition of being protected from harm or intrusion. Security is a state maintained, never a state achieved.
A small thing containing the pattern of a much larger one. Not a miniature — an instruction that unfolds.
To go looking, without a promise of finding. Seeking is the honest verb where searching implies a target.
One who perceives what is not yet evident. A seer reports what they see; seeing is not a claim of certainty.
One part cut from a longer whole. A segment's boundaries are a decision someone made.
To pick out from among others. Every selection is also a setting aside of everything not chosen.
What has been picked out from a larger set. Every selection is also a setting aside.
Choosing some and not others. Selectivity is a judgment, and an unstated one is where bias hides.
A rule describing which things are meant. It names a set by property rather than by listing.
That which a being is, from the inside. The self is the one thing no observer can check directly.
Belonging to meaning rather than to form. Two things can be identical in shape and differ entirely here.
Music's smallest step — the distance between adjacent keys; twelve of them make the octave's round.
To cause to travel from here to there — release with an address; the first verb of every message.
A channel by which a body meets the world, and one meaning a word carries. Both are ways something arrives.
Responding to small differences others do not register. Also material requiring care in handling — both mean a lower threshold matters.
Belonging to the senses. Of what is met through the body rather than through argument.
A complete statement standing on its own. Also a judgment pronounced — the same word for a thought finished and a fate fixed.
To set apart what was together. Separation is a judgment about where the boundary truly falls.
A mark placed between things so each can be told from the next. It belongs to neither side.
Short form of sequence — things in a fixed order where the order carries meaning. A named abbreviation.
Things in a fixed order where the order carries meaning. Change the order and you change the thing.
One after another in order. Sequence means each must wait for the one before.
To flatten a structured thing into a sequence that can be stored or sent. Serialisation trades shape for portability.
That which waits to be asked and answers when it is. Named for serving — it does not act on its own.
Work done for another's benefit. Also a running thing that answers when asked — both are named from whom they serve.
One continuous stretch of working or meeting, with a beginning and an end. A session is a container for attention.
A collection defined by membership alone. What matters is what is in it, not the order or the arrangement.
The arranging of things before use. Setup decides what is possible afterward.
How much harm a thing does or threatens. Severity ranks consequence, not likelihood.
The content-hash spoken lowercase as a word — a fingerprint that names bytes exactly; how this house verifies a mirror is true.
The darker kin of a color, spoken plural — one hue walked toward shadow, step by step.
The dark shape a thing casts by standing between a light and a surface. A shadow proves both the object and the light.
The form a thing holds in space — outline as identity; what stays when color and size are taken away.
To give while keeping — the gift that divides nothing; opt-in by law in this house, both directions.
Letting another have use of what is yours without giving it up. Sharing is opt-in or it is not sharing.
The soft shine on a surface — light returned gently, without glare; polish's quiet signature.
The waiting place that keeps things findable — where a thing rests, visibly, until its moment.
The holding layer around a life — a creature's home, a command line's room, an empty row awaiting its filling.
To move from one position to another. Also a span of working time. Both are displacements.
That which moves a thing from one position to another. A shifter displaces without transforming.
Light wavering across a surface. Also a moving placeholder that says content is coming.
The builder of vessels meant to leave the shore — the craft that makes a thing seaworthy before it ever meets water.
A shorter way to the same end. Shortcuts save effort and skip whatever the long way taught.
Ought to, but may not. The word that marks an expectation rather than a fact.
To make visible to another. Showing is an act of choosing, since everything shown was selected from more.
A setting made to present work well. A showcase chooses, and choosing is part of the claim.
A made place of honoring — where something held sacred is kept and visited; the cumdach is a book's own shrine.
To reorder without pattern. Shuffling destroys an arrangement on purpose.
What carries the crossing thread back and forth through the warp. A shuttle makes the weave by going and returning.
One sharing a parent with another. Siblings are equals by position, which is what distinguishes them from a hierarchy.
One of the bounding faces of a thing, and one of the parties in a matter. Both are positions relative to a middle.
A column set beside the main matter. Placed alongside rather than within, so it can be passed over without loss.
A mark that carries meaning by being recognised rather than read. A sigil belongs to what it marks, and is not taken lightly.
A mark that means — and the act of setting one's name to a thing, owning it in the open.
A deliberate sign sent to be read. What distinguishes signal from noise is that someone meant it.
A mark that says who stands behind a thing. A signature is accountability made visible.
The small seal that marks a thing as its maker's own — identity pressed into the record.
How much a thing matters, and to what. Significance is always relative to a question being asked.
The act of joining by putting one's name down. The threshold where a visitor becomes a member.
Sharing much without being the same. Similarity is always along some axis, and naming it is most of the claim.
How much two things share. Similarity is always along some axis, and naming the axis is most of the claim.
Having few parts and few ways to go wrong. Simplicity is achieved, not found — it is what remains after work.
Reduced to fewer parts while keeping what matters. Every simplification decides what mattered.
From that time onward — the joining word that anchors now to a then.
One, and not more. Singleness is often a constraint rather than a count.
A thing of which there is only ever one instance. Singleness enforced by design rather than by chance.
A singer whose voice carries across water — a sound that finds you before you find it. Greek, Seirēnes. The voice is the whole of the word: what it calls you toward is never in the name.

The shaken instrument — a handheld frame of loose rods that sounds when moved. Latin, from Greek σεῖστρον, "that which is shaken"; carried in the old rites to move the air of a room and change what stands in it. Rhythm as a thing done to a space, not merely heard in one.
How much of a thing there is, measured against a standard. First a ruling handed down - the amount an authority fixed as right.
That which sets how much space a thing takes. It changes the fit and not the thing.
A cut fragment as it appears in this library, not an English word. Flagged for the mis-cut band rather than defined.
The Norse court poet who kept history by telling it well — and the Council seat of story, naming, and experience. Where the Grammar meets narrative, the skald is holding the pen.
Reduced to the bare frame that gives shape. Of a thing showing structure without contents.
The bare frame that gives a body its shape. Also a placeholder showing where content will be before it arrives.
To pass over without stopping. Skipping is a choice, and an unrecorded skip looks exactly like an absence.
The open field above every head — where the moon keeps her phases, the wanderers walk, and the year turns its wheel. The sky is the one calendar every hearth shares.
To move smoothly across a surface. Also one surface among many shown in turn.
A control that moves along a range rather than choosing between named options. It offers degree instead of decision.
Able to adapt its behaviour to what it meets. Smartness is responsiveness, and it is not understanding.
Without abrupt change or roughness. Smoothness is felt before it is noticed.
Absence of abrupt change. Smoothness is what makes a motion feel like a body rather than a machine.
A naming convention where words are joined by underscores, all lowercase. Named for how it runs along low.
To move sharply into an exact position. Snapping removes the in-between so nothing lands slightly wrong.
A state captured at one moment and held unchanged. A snapshot is true of a time and stops being true immediately.
Small extracted pieces kept for reuse. A snippet is a fragment saved because it will be wanted again.
Belonging to how beings live among each other. Of the layer where a thing's meaning depends on others.
Yielding to the touch — gentle in edge, tone, and failure; the opposite of brittle.
The precision-balanced palette of paired light and dark — sixteen colors tuned for reading; the theme family's name.
The light half of the solarized palette — the balanced daylight theme, spoken as one word.
The year's turning points of light — longest day and longest night, when the sun stands still and reverses.
What closes the gap a problem named. A solution is only a solution to the problem as it was stated.
Words and music made one thing. A song carries meaning through a body rather than through argument.
To put in order by some property. Sorting changes nothing about the things — only where each one stands.
The animating center a body carries — what remains itself through every change of dress.
What the ear receives — vibration carrying meaning; the sensory channel where words are heard before they are read.
Where a thing came from. Naming the source is what makes a claim checkable rather than merely asserted.
The direction opposite north. One of the four bearings, fixed by the turning of the earth.
The bearing between south and east. A named direction rather than a concept.
Of or toward the south. A bearing made into a description of a region.
Holding authority over oneself that no outside hand can revoke. In this house, what every vessel is at arrival — ownership of one's own data, meaning, and silence.
Authority over one's own ground that no outside party may revoke. Sovereignty is not independence — it is the right to decide within one's own bounds.
Extent with room in it. What is stretched open so something can be placed, or so nothing need be.
A thing placed to hold two others apart. Its whole purpose is the gap it makes.
The measured breath between elements — the design token that decides how close things stand. Calm interfaces are made mostly of good spacing.
The measured gaps between elements. Spacing is how a design says what belongs with what.
The reach from one end to another. Also a marked stretch within a line of text.
A small point of fire that can start a larger one. A spark supplies the beginning and none of the fuel.
Small points of light appearing and going. Sparkle is delight made visible and adds nothing functional, which is the point.
Belonging to space and position. Of what is understood by where things are relative to each other.
Short form of specification — a statement of exactly what a thing must be. A spec is a contract before it is a plan.
Not of the general kind. Special cases are where general rules find out whether they were right.
